steps.fms: const a = [...fps.active.availableArrivals].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (a.length) await fps.setArrival(a[0].databaseId);
const p = [...fps.active.availableApproaches].sort((x, y) => x.ident.localeCompare(y.ident)); if (p.length) await fps.setApproach(p[0].databaseId);

const p = fps.active; let i = p.allLegs.findIndex((e) => !e.isDiscontinuity && e.definition && e.definition.waypoint && e.type === 'IF' && p.allLegs.indexOf(e) > 0); if (i < 0) i = 1; p.setActiveLegIndex(i);
